empty: Open a folder workspace to edit its settings.

website.description: How this workspace exports as a website. Saved to .glyph/site.json, so it travels with the folder.

title.label: Site title
title.hint: browser tab, header, and social cards

favicon.label: Favicon path
favicon.hint: workspace-relative; a root favicon.ico/png/svg is picked up automatically

socialImage.label: Social image path
socialImage.hint: shown in link previews; needs a base URL

dailyNotes.description: Where Open Today's Note keeps each day's note. Saved to .glyph/config.json, so it travels with the folder.

folder.label: Folder
folder.hint: workspace-relative; empty for the workspace root

filenamePattern.label: File name pattern
filenamePattern.hint: YYYY, YY, MM, M, DD, and D are replaced by today's date; [text] in brackets is kept as written

template.label: Template file
template.hint: workspace-relative; copied into each new note

errors.invalidPath: The folder, file name pattern, and template can't contain ".." or any of < > : " | ? *
